basic_details.job_title: PGIMER Labour Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, is filling 01 (one) post of Labour Officer on deputation basis in Pay Level-10 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. The post is open only to Labour Officers of the Central Pool/State Pool with the required regular service. Applications on the prescribed proforma must be sent through the Head of the Department/Organization to the Director, PGIMER, Chandigarh and must reach by 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About PGIMER Labour Officer
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research, Chandigarh, is an Institute of National Importance under an Act of Parliament. It provides medical treatment to patients of the surrounding areas and regions besides academic courses for doctors, and has a sanctioned strength of about 7500 Group B and C employees. Because of this large workforce, the institute needs a Labour Officer to deal with the day-to-day labour problems. The recruitment is handled by the Establishment Branch – I(2), Non-Faculty Section, Administrative Block, PGIMER, Sector-12, Chandigarh – 160 012 (Phone: 0172-2755604, 5513; e-mail: [email protected] ).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The PGIMER Labour Officer application is not sent directly by the candidate. It goes through the officer's own employer: Fill the prescribed proforma for the post of Labour Officer (Pay Level-10) on deputation basis, which is available on the official website of the Institute (it is also printed as the last page of the notice). Paste your latest passport size photograph in the box on the proforma and sign it. Attach attested copies of your ACR/APARs for the preceding five years. Submit the application to the Head of your Department/Organization for forwarding. The forwarding authority must ensure that no departmental/disciplinary proceedings are pending or being contemplated against you and furnish a certificate to this effect, along with an experience certificate in respect of your job profile. The application is addressed to: The Director, PGIMER, Chandigarh, and must reach by 7 December 2026. If the application cannot be sent through proper channel before the last date, an advance copy may be sent, accompanied by APARs for the preceding five years duly certified by the competent authority. The candidature will be considered only after the application is received through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Labour Officer, on deputation basis, in Pay Level-10 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC. Applications are invited from the Central Pool/State Pool of Labour Officers having: at least 02 years of regular service in Pay Level-09 (Grade Pay-5400); or 04 years of regular service in Pay Level-8 (Grade Pay-4800); or 05 years of regular service in Pay Level-7 (Grade Pay-4600). The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the proforma only asks applicants to state their educational qualifications. The age limit is not specified in the notice either, though the proforma asks for the date of birth and the date of retirement. The deputation shall ordinarily be for three years. The notice does not mention allowances or other benefits beyond the pay level. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application on the prescribed proforma, with the latest passport size photograph pasted and the candidate's signature Attested copies of ACR/APARs for the preceding five years Certificate from the forwarding authority that no departmental/disciplinary proceedings are pending/being contemplated against the officer Experience certificate in respect of the job profile of the officer The proforma itself asks for: name (in capital letters); address with telephone number and e-mail address; date of birth; date of retirement; educational qualifications; name and address of the present employer; dates of appointment on regular basis in Level-7 (Grade Pay ₹4600), Level-8 (Grade Pay ₹4800), Level-9 (Grade Pay ₹5400) and Level-10 (₹15600-39100 + Grade Pay ₹5400); pay scale/pay level drawn by virtue of MACP or otherwise; nature of present employment; total emoluments drawn per month; ACR grading for the last five years; and any additional information in support of your ability for the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PGIMER Labour Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) post of Labour Officer on deputation basis at PGIMER, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the PGIMER Labour Officer application?
faq.answer: The application, sent through the Head of the Department/Organization, must reach the Director, PGIMER, Chandigarh by 7 December 2026; late applications will be rejected summarily.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the PGIMER Labour Officer post?
faq.answer: Labour Officers of the Central Pool/State Pool with at least 02 years of regular service in Pay Level-09 (Grade Pay-5400), or 04 years in Pay Level-8 (Grade Pay-4800), or 05 years in Pay Level-7 (Grade Pay-4600).

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the PGIMER Labour Officer post?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Level-10 of the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation shall ordinarily be for three years.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the PGIMER Labour Officer post?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed proforma available on the Institute's official website, attach attested ACR/APARs for the preceding five years, and send it through the Head of your Department/Organization to the Director, PGIMER, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must go with the application?
faq.answer: Attested copies of ACR/APARs for the preceding five years, a certificate that no departmental/disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated against the officer, and an experience certificate on the officer's job profile.

faq.question: Q8. What if my application cannot go through proper channel before the last date?
faq.answer: An advance copy may be sent with APARs for the preceding five years duly certified by the competent authority, but candidature will be considered only after the application through proper channel is received.
